# Pantograph layout

## The idea in one line
html font-size = viewport width / mockup width.
At the mockup width 1rem is exactly 1px of the mockup.

## Breakpoints
| up to 499px | 375  | 0.853px → 1.333px |
| 500–1151px  | 768  | 0.651px → 1.5px   |
| 1152px+     | 1440 | 0.8px → 1.111px   |
